---
title: Help shape what comes next.
description: Contribute ideas, research expertise, and practical feedback as TSP develops.
---

TSP is building a foundation for useful, accessible youth service programming and evidence-informed advocacy. Contributions can begin with a careful question, a correction, or an insight from your community.

## Bring your perspective

**Young people:** help identify what makes a service opportunity meaningful, accessible, and realistic. Future participant materials should make room for your priorities and feedback.

**Facilitators and communities:** critique the proposed event model, describe practical constraints, and suggest adaptations. [Read the community learning approach](programs/feedback.qmd).

**Researchers and policy contributors:** suggest verifiable sources, public datasets, useful methods, and questions about national service. [Explore the research agenda](research/national-service.qmd).

**Readers:** point out unclear language, accessibility problems, factual errors, or claims that need better evidence.

## Current contribution route

Contributors comfortable with GitHub can [open the collaboration workspace](https://github.com/everettsaccount/tsp) and use its issue templates for research suggestions, resource feedback, and technical problems. Instructions are in its CONTRIBUTING.md file. GitHub is a working space, not a prerequisite for future program participation.

Public contact channels are still being configured. Until a suitable contact route is available, this site does not collect messages, registrations, email addresses, or participant information. Please do not post personal or confidential information in public issues.

## Participating or hosting in the future

Interested communities can review the [hosting considerations](programs/hosting.qmd). Specific events, dates, participation arrangements, and contact information will be announced after they are confirmed. No event registration, donation, or volunteer signup system is offered in this alpha.
